Call SetRed(oDoc.getMasterPages())

Sub SetRed(oPages)
Dim i, j, oPage, oShape
For i = 0 To oPages.getCount()-1
oPage = oPages.getByIndex(i)
For j = 0 To oPage.getCount()-1
oShape = oPage.getByIndex(j)
If oShape.supportsService("com.sun.star.presentation.SlideNumberShape") Then
oShape.CharColor = RGB(255,0,0)
End If
Next j
Next i
End Sub

On Error Resume Next
Dim oDoc, oPages, oPage, oShape, e1, e2, par, por, fld
Dim i, j, k, n, s, hit, t
oDoc = ThisComponent
s = ""
n = 0
For k = 0 To 1
If k = 0 Then
oPages = oDoc.getDrawPages()
Else
oPages = oDoc.getMasterPages()
End If
For i = 0 To oPages.getCount()-1
oPage = oPages.getByIndex(i)
For j = 0 To oPage.getCount()-1
oShape = oPage.getByIndex(j)
t = oShape.ShapeType
hit = False
If InStr(t, "SlideNumber") > 0 Then hit = True
If oShape.supportsService("com.sun.star.drawing.Text") Then
e1 = oShape.createEnumeration()
Do While e1.hasMoreElements()
par = e1.nextElement()
e2 = par.createEnumeration()
Do While e2.hasMoreElements()
por = e2.nextElement()
fld = Nothing
fld = por.TextField
If Not IsNull(fld) Then
s = s & "F=" & fld.getImplementationName() & Chr(10)
If InStr(fld.getImplementationName(), "Page") > 0 Then hit = True
If InStr(fld.getImplementationName(), "Number") > 0 Then hit = True
If fld.supportsService("com.sun.star.text.textfield.PageNumber") Then hit = True
If fld.supportsService("com.sun.star.presentation.TextField.PageNumber") Then hit = True
End If
Loop
Loop
End If
If k = 1 Or i = 0 Then
s = s & k & "/" & i & "/" & j & " " & t & " [" & Left(oShape.String, 8) & "]" & Chr(10)
End If
If hit Then
oShape.CharColor = RGB(255,0,0)
n = n + 1
End If
Next j
Next i
Next k
oDoc.store()
MsgBox "n=" & n & Chr(10) & s
End Sub
